summary: nixorokish 把 EIP-8037 状态创建 gas 上调列入 Glamsterdam 元 EIP 的 CFI 并合并。后量子交易签名（PQTS）专场发布启动会议程，首次会议 2 月 4 日。yperbasis 明确 EIP-7778 不改变用户 gas 计算，提交并合并。stevieraykatz 的 Associated Accounts ERC 合并。

items.title: EIP-7773：EIP-8037 列为 CFI
items.note: （nixorokish）合并，1 月 20 日提交；EIP-7778：明确用户 gas 计算保持不变（yperbasis）提交并合并，恢复在 PR 11099 中被删除的用户 gas 计算一节。

keywords_en: EIP-8037 formally listed as CFI for Glamsterdam
the post-quantum transaction signature breakout launches
EIP-7778 keeps user gas accounting unchanged
Optimism's custom gas token matches native rollups
summary_en: nixorokish listed EIP-8037, the state creation gas increase, as CFI in the Glamsterdam meta EIP, merged. The post-quantum transaction signature (PQTS) breakout posted its kickoff agenda, first meeting February 4. yperbasis clarified EIP-7778 leaves user gas accounting unchanged, submitted and merged. stevieraykatz's Associated Accounts ERC merged.
